plainText:
Yveltal Steals (Japanese: イベルタル、奪う Yveltal, Take) is the 590th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 42nd chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
Xerxer continues battling as , , and watch on with both their Charizard, with Yveltal using and to attack Xerxer with increasing ferocity. As the group debates helping Xerxer to swing the battle in its favor, Xerxer telepathically reminds them that their priority is to head to Pokémon Village and stop the ultimate weapon from being activated again. Y volunteers to stay behind with Trevor to regroup with and , and Blue states that he sneaked Diantha out of the battle with Xerosic so she can also head to the Village. However, as the two Charizard wielders fly off, it turns out that Diantha has already been cornered by Malva, who has her strike Diantha with its wings to finish her off.

As Blue and X fly over Snowbelle City towards Pokémon Village, X considers the information at hand: while Xerxer and Yveltal are fighting harder than ever, hasn't shown up in response to their battle despite Team Flare claiming no knowledge of its capture. The two of them reach the Village to find it deserted, only to be suddenly attacked by , who Blue recognizes. Despite this, Mewtwo is in an intense rage and refuses to heed Blue's calls, sending the two Trainers flying back with . Lysandre arrives on the scene, gloating that Mewtwo has decided to deal with his enemies instead, revealing that Mewtwo is the guardian of Pokémon Village who hid itself away until a night prior. Blue concludes that Team Flare kidnapped the village Pokémon to power the ultimate weapon, which Lysandre doesn't deny, and calls for the boys to put up a good fight with Mewtwo so he can capture it after it's been weakened. As if in response to this, Mewtwo releases a barrage of into the air, but redirects the attack at the last minute to hit Lysandre and his instead. As Lysandre scowls, Mewtwo suddenly Mega Evolves into Mega Mewtwo Y, causing Blue and Lysandre to realize that the Trainer responsible must be nearby. Recognizing this, Lysandre produces a remote control and activates it.

At his house in Camphrier Town, Cassius and his gang realize that Emma accessed her Pokémon Storage a few days prior at , prompting them to head out to search for her. As Mewtwo fights all of Lysandre's Pokémon at once, Zygarde suddenly emerges from the ground with a terrific upheaval.

==Major events==
Xerxer continues its battle against .
and decide to stay behind and help and while and head to the Pokémon Village.
Diantha is revealed to have awakened, but is intercepted by Malva.
X and Blue arrive at the village, but are attacked by .
Lysandre appears and reveals that Mewtwo is the protector of the Pokémon Village.
Mewtwo Mega Evolves into Mega Mewtwo Y.
Blue notices another person in the distance who was responsible for Mega Evolving Mewtwo.
Lysandre uses a device to summon .
